name: Low Idiosyncratic-Volatility Defensive Tilt
description: Long-only tilt toward the lowest-idiosyncratic-volatility assets (Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang 2006). Idiosyncratic volatility is the residual standard deviation from a market-model regression on IWRD/VUSA, neutralising market-driven variance. Ranks ascending and equal-weights the bottom N. Distinct from total-vol LowVolatilityTilt and systematic-beta LowBetaTilt.
